description: This is a test class for ChangeLogVersionFinder, which appears to handle versioning and filename mappings for Liquibase changelogs within the OpenMRS project. The file contains unit tests that verify methods for retrieving specific changelog files based on version strings, as well as logic for parsing and comparing version names.

classes.name: ChangeLogVersionFinderTest
classes.description: Contains unit tests for ChangeLogVersionFinder methods, verifying correct filename retrieval and version comparisons.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes mocked dependencies for unit tests, setting up version lists.

methods.name: shouldGetLiquibaseChangeSetCombinations
methods.description: Verifies the correct mapping of version to corresponding changelog filenames.

methods.name: shouldGetLiquibaseSnapshotCombinations
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of snapshot filename combinations per version.

methods.name: shouldGetLiquibaseSnapshotFilenames
methods.description: Tests retrieval of snapshot filenames based on a version string.

methods.name: shouldGetLatestLiquibaseSnapshotVersion
methods.description: Verifies retrieving the latest snapshot version.

methods.name: shouldGetLatestLiquibaseSchemaSnapshotFilename
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of the latest schema snapshot filename.

methods.name: shouldGetLatestLiquibaseCoreDataSnapshotFilename
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of the latest core data snapshot filename.

methods.name: shouldGetUpdateVersionsGreaterThanOtherVersion
methods.description: Checks that the method correctly returns update versions greater than a specified version.

methods.name: shouldGetNoUpdateVersionsGreaterThanFutureVersion
methods.description: Verifies behavior when querying update versions for a non-existing future version.

methods.name: shouldHandleEmtpyString
methods.description: Ensures an exception is thrown when an empty string is supplied for version comparison.

methods.name: shouldGetLiquibaseUpdateFileNames
methods.description: Tests filename retrieval for given version list.

methods.name: shouldGetLiquibaseSnapshotVersions
methods.description: Verifies the published list of snapshot versions.

methods.name: shouldGetLiquibaseUpdateVersions
methods.description: Verifies the published list of update versions.

methods.name: shouldGetVersionAsDotXFromShortVersionName
methods.description: Tests conversion of a short version string to a dot-x format.

methods.name: shouldGetVersionAsDotXFromLongVersionName
methods.description: Tests conversion of a long version string to a dot-x format.

methods.name: shouldHandleNonPatternMatchingVersionName
methods.description: Ensures an exception is thrown for non-matching version string formats.
